next.reason: 1985: 'The leftmost position of the print line is considered to be column number 1.' §2023:13.18.14.4 GR7: 'a horizontal counter, representing the rightmost occupied column ... At the start of the line, the horizontal counter is zero', which puts the line's first position at column 1 for every absolute column a 1985 program writes. §2023:13.18.14.4 GR8 ('Integer-2 specifies a relative column number') is removed from the targets: it governs only integer-2, which the 1985 format (COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-1) lacks.
